name: BL-010 criteria, addendum 1: Monday-open repricing (Phase 2 step 7)
adds_to: bl010_criteria.json - unchanged; this file only adds a step that file does not have
rule: Committed before the step ran. Never edited after results are seen: a change is a new file that names this one as superseded, with the reason.
reason: Owner decision 2026-10-05: a new Broad run keeps signal_delay 0, and Phase 2 measures the cost of trading at Monday's open instead of Friday's close. The flag level is fixed here so that 'does the gap matter' is not decided after seeing it.

monday_open_repricing.what: The engine's own trade list for each of the six Phase 2 configs, every fill moved from the fill week's last close to the next trading day's open
monday_open_repricing.flag_applies_to: any one of the six configs
monday_open_repricing.if_flagged: Broad gets a Monday-fill execution option and results are quoted on it; a week's signal delay is not the fix
